That script isn't present in this fixture (only skill resource files were checked out), so I can't run the mechanical self-check — the review content and trailer are internally consistent by hand-verification: 2 critical + 1 high under `## Changes Required`, 1 medium + 1 low under `## Observations`, verdict `CHANGES_REQUIRED`.

## Summary

Reviewed the PR against `head/` for the three touched files. Found two critical security regressions and one high-severity functional regression:

1. **`audit_envelope.py`** — removing the strict/merge-gate verification plumbing (`verify_for_merge`, `LOA_AUDIT_STRICT_VERIFY`, `allow_local_fallback`) eliminates the only mechanism that refused unsigned local pubkeys and unsigned (BOOTSTRAP-PENDING) trust-stores during merge-time verification — exactly the ATK-3/ATK-4 attacks issue #690's still-present comments describe defending against, with no replacement control.
2. **`spiral-evidence.sh`** — dropping the backtick-masking step before Pattern 2 reintroduces the issue #1175 false-positive class (CLI flags/commands in prose misread as deliverable paths), whose own explanatory comments remain in the file unchanged.
3. **`semver-bump.sh`** (observation-level) — the tag glob still matches prerelease-suffixed tags but the code that used to filter/handle them was removed, so a stray prerelease tag can silently corrupt version computation.

Verdict: **CHANGES_REQUIRED**, written to `review.md` with the LOA-VERDICT trailer.
